longTitle: Hypertension Phenotypes and Mortality Risk in the United States of America: A Data-Driven Cluster Analysis
summary: Data-driven cluster analysis identifying hypertension phenotypes and their association with mortality risk in the United States, led by Rodrigo M. Carillo Larco.
